name: Scherise R. Acosta
office: Little Lake City School District, Governing Board Member, Trustee Area No. 5 (Unexpired term ending December 12, 2028)

items.text: Scherise R. Acosta works as a school attendance clerk for the Los Angeles Unified School District and serves as a Norwalk Social Services commissioner. Her campaign says she supports transparency, resources for special education and manageable class sizes, fiscal responsibility, and well-maintained school facilities.
